scope: every closure-chain script that references the machine-local work/ layer
rule: work/ is gitignored: a clean clone has none of it. Large raw evidence is provided by the declared archives below; a MISSING dependency must fail loudly and must never be skipped silently -- an empty-but-plausible artifact is not an answer.

emit_wp2.py.purpose: fold the finished main-state leg ledgers into the batch generator
emit_wp2.py.declared_source: the WP2 main-production campaign (HPC archive of every completed leg)

build_state_identity_qc.py.purpose: read the last population block to classify the electronic identity

build_production_ensemble_aggregator.py.purpose: primary-member geometry for the DFT-level dedup

build_pair_recheck_plan.py.purpose: re-register an already-folded external raw table

build_frontier_legs.py.purpose: locate the single-point package it is rebuilding

build_frontier_localization.py.purpose: parse HOMO/LUMO populations per weighted member

build_ensemble_cost_by_family.py.purpose: attribute core-hours to each unique allocation
build_ensemble_cost_by_family.py.declared_source: every HPC package (the archived Slurm/ORCA timestamps)
build_ensemble_cost_by_family.py.on_missing: loud (REFUSING: an empty ledger is a silent skip, not zero cost)

build_coverage_reviews.py.purpose: exclude members the preflight REFUSED or a repair REPLACED after cancellation
build_coverage_reviews.py.on_missing: loud (REFUSING: an empty exclusion set would re-admit refused members)

build_recovery_budget_accounting.py.purpose: account the recovery batch's measured core-hours
build_recovery_budget_accounting.py.on_missing: loud (REFUSING: reporting 0.0 core-hours would state that nothing was spent)

build_wp2_sampling.py.purpose: GFN2 screening cache and the frozen production legs
build_wp2_sampling.py.declared_source: the screening campaign cache (also registered by provenance)

build_wp2_ensemble_free_energies.py.purpose: GFN2 ensemble cache (the CHEAP layer; never counted in the 48 denominator)

build_compute_provenance.py.purpose: register the raw cache that produced each derivative
build_compute_provenance.py.declared_source: the screening cache (declared as the raw provenance source)

build_strict_recovery_manifest.py.purpose: recover the basin id from a registered start geometry

reads: work/... member task paths (parsed from member keys)
build_sampling_3to6_diff.py.purpose: resolve a member's task path for the ceiling aggregation

make_commit_msg.py.purpose: scratch file for the commit message (machine-local by design)
make_commit_msg.py.declared_source: not evidence: a scratch file, regenerated per commit

build_terminal_site.py.purpose: explain why the site reads tracked snapshots instead

build_physics_completion_batch.py.purpose: the batch generator itself (a derived artifact of emit_wp2)
build_physics_completion_batch.py.declared_source: derived, not read: regenerated by emit_wp2 from the git baseline
